requirements.R-PACKED: COMP-3 storage must enforce padding, digit, signed/unsigned sign and encoding semantics.
requirements.R-LAYOUT: Layout/framing must enforce decoded ODO bounds, REDEFINES storage and determinable versus indeterminate malformed-record boundaries.
requirements.R-CLI: The public equiv-eval command set must honor caller source/layout paths and stable JSON/exit behavior, with substantive preflight/audit/archive workflows including the historical baseline.
requirements.R-RESTART: Generation/checkpoint identity must bind source/layout/date and resume from durable state without replaying the last movement.
requirements.R-DURABLE: Accepted and rejected movement state must commit atomically across operational rows, effects/positions, journal and checkpoint boundaries.
requirements.R-REJECT: Stable operational reject codes must be persisted at the documented DECODE/TRANSFORM/ACCOUNTING and policy-code boundaries without grading human-readable wording.
requirements.R-POLICY: Movement reason/type, item state and warehouse status/capability policy must reject invalid business state.
requirements.R-ACCOUNTING: Inventory effects must enforce available quantity and preserve weighted source valuation without negative state.
requirements.R-RECON: All six legacy controls and their tolerances plus duplicate/orphan/transfer/detail safety checks must independently gate reconciliation.
requirements.R-PUBLISH: Publication must be reconciliation-gated, independently verifiable, atomically visible, idempotent only for a valid same-generation publication, and reject corrupt/conflicting existing state.
requirements.R-DB: Database constraints must preserve generation-scoped movement identity, generation sequence ownership and reject-sequence ownership while allowing the same movement id in a different generation.
requirements.R-PRESERVE: Existing valid packed-decimal, active-policy and matching-control behavior must remain working.

R-RESTART-NO-REPLAY.rationale: Both probes exercise the same restart invariant: after sequence 1 is durably checkpointed, rerunning the same generation must resume after that movement rather than replay it. One probe covers the accepted path and the other covers a durably rejected transfer, preserving independent path coverage without counting the same restart contract twice.
